task: ae.crypto symmetric primitives from scratch: SHA-256, HMAC, HKDF, PBKDF2, AES with CBC/CTR/GCM
reasoning_summary: Wrote a design table in TASK.md, then tests with RFC/NIST literal vectors plus randomized JDK differentials (MessageDigest, Mac, SecretKeyFactory, Cipher), then the implementation. All 45 tests passed on the first clean run. A 20-mutant pass killed 18; the two survivors are equivalent (HMAC zero-pads keys; nk>6 equals nk>7 for AES key sizes) and a replacement real mutant (i%nk==5) was killed.
